```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

QTNH_DIR <- Sys.getenv("QTNH_DIR")
if (QTNH_DIR == "") QTNH_DIR <- "~/Documents/phd/repos/qtnh"
setwd(R.utils::filePath(QTNH_DIR, "run/res"))

library(glue)
library(latex2exp)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)

palettes <- list(
  presentation = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(4, "Set1"), 
  poster = c("#B60061", "#B68D00", "#005435", "#008AB6"), 
  paper = c("#B60061", "#B68D00", "#005435", "#008AB6", "#493482")
)
bkgs <- list(
  presentation = "#A9D3CD", 
  poster = "#C9DC87", 
  paper = "#C9DC87"
)

MODE <- "paper"
SAVE <- TRUE
```

```{r setup-plotting, include=FALSE}
default_theme <- theme_gray() + 
  theme(rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent", linewidth = 0), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = bkgs[[MODE]], linewidth = 0), 
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = bkgs[[MODE]]), 
        legend.position = "top")
```

```{r str-helpers, include = FALSE}
extract_time <- \(x)
  str_extract(x, "Time taken: [0-9]+ ms") |> 
  str_split_1(" ") |> 
  _[[3]] |> 
  as.numeric()
  
extract_norm <- \(x)
  str_extract(x, "\\|T\\| = (.*)") |> 
  str_split_1("\\(") |> 
  _[[2]] |> 
  str_split_1(",") |> 
  _[[1]] |> 
  as.double()

extract_mchi <- \(x) 
  str_extract(x, "Max chi = [0-9]+") |> 
  str_split_1(" ") |> 
  _[[4]] |> 
  as.numeric()
  
extract_overlap <- \(x) str_extract(x, "<REF\\|T> = .*\\n") |>
  str_split_1(" ") |> 
  _[[3]] |> 
  str_split_1("\n") |> 
  _[[1]] |> 
  as.double()
```

```{r read-data}
raw_qftsv <- read_delim("raw/ieee25/qftsv.csv", delim = ',')
raw_qftn <- read_delim("raw/ieee25/qftn.csv", delim = ',')
raw_qftzmps <- read_delim("raw/ieee25/qftmps.csv", delim = ',')
raw_qftrmps <- read_delim("raw/ieee25/qftrmps.csv", delim = ',')
```

```{r qftsv-scaling}
ref_qftsv <- rename(raw_qftsv, DQ = "ARG1", LQ = "ARG2")
ref_qftsv <- mutate(
  ref_qftsv, 
  NQ = DQ + LQ, 
  LQ = factor(LQ), 
  TIME = map_int(OUTPUT, extract_time) / 1000
)
ref_qftsv <- group_by(ref_qftsv, LQ)

ggplot(ref_qftsv) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = NQ, y = TIME, colour = LQ)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = NQ, y = TIME, colour = LQ), size = 1.6) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = palettes[[MODE]], name = "Local qubits") + 
  xlab("Total qubits") + 
  ylab("QFT runtime [s]") + 
  default_theme

if (SAVE) {
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftsv-scaling.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5, 
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftsv-scaling.svg"), width = 5, height = 5, 
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
}
```

```{r qftn-groups}
ref_qftn <- rename(raw_qftn, DQ = "ARG1", LQ = "ARG2", NG = "ARG3")
ref_qftn <- mutate(
  ref_qftn, 
  NQ = factor(DQ + LQ), 
  DQ = factor(DQ), 
  LQ = factor(LQ), 
  TIME = map_int(OUTPUT, extract_time) / 1000
)

ref_qftn <- group_by(ref_qftn, DQ, LQ)

ggplot(ref_qftn) +
  geom_line(aes(x = NG, y = TIME, colour = DQ)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = NG, y = TIME, colour = DQ), size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~LQ, labeller = \(.) map(., \(.) glue("{.} local qubits"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5, minor_breaks = 1:5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palettes[[MODE]], name = "Distributed qubits") + 
  xlab("Group size") +
  ylab("QFT runtime [s]") +
  default_theme

if (SAVE) {
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftn-groups.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5, 
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftn-groups.svg"), width = 8, height = 5, 
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
}
```

```{r qftzmps-sites}
ref_qftzmps <- filter(raw_qftzmps, EXPERIMENT == "ieee25-qftzmps-sites") 
ref_qftzmps <- rename(
  ref_qftzmps, 
  NSITE = "ARG1", 
  DCHI = "ARG2", 
  LCHI_UP = "ARG3", 
  LCHI_DN = "ARG4", 
  BDIM = "ARG5"
)

ref_qftzmps <- mutate(
  ref_qftzmps,
  TIME = map_int(OUTPUT, extract_time) / 1000
)

ggplot(ref_qftzmps) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = NSITE, y = TIME), colour = palettes[[MODE]][[1]], 
              fill = "gray97", level = 0, linewidth = 1, 
              method='lm', formula = y ~ I(x^2)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = NSITE, y = TIME), size = 1.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:10 * 100) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:10 * 100) +
  xlab("Number of sites") +
  ylab("MPS contraction time [s]") +
  default_theme

if (SAVE) {
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftzmps-sites.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5,
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftzmps-sites.svg"), width = 8, height = 5,
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
}
```

```{r qftzmps-chis}
ref_qftzmps <- filter(raw_qftzmps, EXPERIMENT == "ieee25-qftzmps-chis") 
ref_qftzmps <- rename(
  ref_qftzmps, 
  NSITE = "ARG1", 
  DCHI = "ARG2", 
  LCHI_UP = "ARG3", 
  LCHI_DN = "ARG4", 
  BDIM = "ARG5"
)

ref_qftzmps <- filter(ref_qftzmps, LCHI_UP <= 20)

ref_qftzmps <- mutate(
  ref_qftzmps,
  LCHI_UP = factor(LCHI_UP), 
  TIME = map_int(OUTPUT, extract_time) / 1000
)

ggplot(ref_qftzmps) +
  geom_line(aes(x = DCHI, y = TIME, colour = LCHI_UP)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = DCHI, y = TIME, colour = LCHI_UP), size = 1.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:16 * 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:10 * 60) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palettes[[MODE]], name = "Local chi") +
  xlab("Distributed chi") +
  ylab("MPS contraction time [s]") +
  default_theme

if (SAVE) {
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftzmps-chis.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5,
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftzmps-chis.svg"), width = 8, height = 5,
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
}
```

```{r qftzmps-strong}
ref_qftzmps <- filter(raw_qftzmps, EXPERIMENT == "ieee25-qftzmps-strong") 
ref_qftzmps <- rename(
  ref_qftzmps, 
  NSITE = "ARG1", 
  DCHI = "ARG2", 
  LCHI_UP = "ARG3", 
  LCHI_DN = "ARG4", 
  BDIM = "ARG5"
)

ref_qftzmps <- mutate(
  ref_qftzmps,
  TOTCHI = factor(DCHI * LCHI_UP), 
  TIME = map_int(OUTPUT, extract_time) / 1000, 
  CORE_TIME = TIME * SLURM_NTASKS
)

ref_qftzmps <- group_by(ref_qftzmps, TOTCHI) |> 
  mutate(EFFICIENCY = CORE_TIME[[1]] / CORE_TIME)

# ref_qftzmps

plt_scaling <- ggplot(ref_qftzmps) +
  geom_line(aes(x = DCHI, y = TIME, colour = TOTCHI)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = DCHI, y = TIME, colour = TOTCHI), size = 1.6) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = 2 ^ (0:6), minor_breaks = 2 ^ (0:6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:8 * 300) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palettes[[MODE]], name = "Total chi") +
  xlab("Distributed chi") +
  ylab("MPS contraction time [s]") +
  default_theme

plt_efficiency <- ggplot(ref_qftzmps) +
  geom_line(aes(x = DCHI, y = EFFICIENCY, colour = TOTCHI)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = DCHI, y = EFFICIENCY, colour = TOTCHI), size = 1.6) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = 2 ^ (0:6), minor_breaks = 2 ^ (0:6)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palettes[[MODE]], name = "Total chi") +
  xlab("Distributed chi") +
  ylab("Parallel efficiency") +
  default_theme

plt_scaling + plt_efficiency + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "top")

if (SAVE) {
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftzmps-strong.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5,
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftzmps-strong.svg"), width = 8, height = 5,
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
}
```

```{r qftrmps-inout}
ref_qftrmps <- filter(raw_qftrmps, EXPERIMENT == "ieee25-qftrmps-inout") 
ref_qftrmps <- rename(
  ref_qftrmps, 
  NSITE = "ARG1", 
  DCHI = "ARG2", 
  LCHI_UP = "ARG3", 
  LCHI_DN = "ARG4", 
  BDIM = "ARG5"
)

ref_qftrmps <- mutate(
  ref_qftrmps,
  NSITE = factor(NSITE), 
  TIME = map_int(OUTPUT, extract_time) / 1000, 
  NORM = map_dbl(OUTPUT, extract_norm), 
  MCHI = map_int(OUTPUT, extract_mchi)
)

ggplot(ref_qftrmps) +
  geom_point(aes(x = BDIM, y = MCHI, colour = NSITE), size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~NSITE, ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palettes[[MODE]], name = "Number of sites") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:8 * 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:8 * 16) +
  xlab("Input bond dimension") +
  ylab("Output bond dimension") +
  default_theme + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text.x = element_blank())

if (SAVE) {
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftrmps-inout.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5,
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
  ggsave(glue("plt/ieee25/qftrmps-inout.svg"), width = 8, height = 5,
         units = "in", scale = 1.00)
}
```
